caption:
Mobile repair shop pe aadha din "phone ready hua?" wale calls mein jaata hai. 📱

2️⃣ Bill amount
3️⃣ Warranty kitne din (yahi proof hai)
4️⃣ Shop timing

Calls kam, trust zyaada. Save karo 🔖
